intention: An authored DEFINITIONAL claim carries, in the artifact that holds it, whether it is Akien's words or CC's read — and a sieve reds when such a claim has propagated into a second artifact with no provenance. The label must travel with the copy, because the copy is where it was lost both times.

Only the author reading it did.' The lived symptom is Akien's, both times, and it is the same sentence: he reads a document written under his name and finds a definition in it that he never gave. What makes it costly is not the error but its silence — it propagates at full confidence, wearing no mark that anyone ever wondered.

gates.prove_gate: code-seam's proof gate — the tester runs proofs/ and emits a VALIDATION; verdict and seal from the same hand.
gates.proof_gate: defect-first teeth: a fixture carrying a known unattributed claim must RED, and an accept-everything mutant of the sieve must turn a tooth red (non-vacuity). A check that cannot red is the failure this corpus has already met twice.
gates.durability_gate: not done until proven AND committed (git).

watchme.trigger: the sieve running over both roots' authored artifacts — charters, notes, decisions, and press_office prose
watchme.enough: the first correction the sieve catches BEFORE Akien reads the artifact — that is the loop closing. The equally informative outcome is the first correction it MISSES, which retires or reshapes it. Akien may retire the watch by ruling.
watchme.carrier: the sieve's report: each flagged claim with the artifacts it appears in and which of them carry provenance
watchme.consumer: Akien — today he is the only detector of this failure class, twice over, and the watch exists to tell him whether anything else has become one
watchme.nexus: questions/ lane one — each miss becomes a constraining question for the sieve's own block
watchme.probe_note: BERTH NAMED AT TICKETING because the emission gate demands a path (cairn/base/watchme_spec.py BERTH_FIELD — the sixth field, not one of Akien's five: ARMED is measured from a path, so a spec with no berth cannot be gated). The path is a COMMITMENT, not a claim the file exists — it does not, and the gate measures ARMED at the crossing that satisfies WATCHME, not now. It moves if decisions/2026-08-05-filters-become-sieves confirms and renames the inspection family's address; that dependency is already this node's [AKIEN] edge.

falsifier: FALSIFIER, RED by physics on any of: (1) a definitional claim appears in two or more authored artifacts where none carries provenance to a verbatim or an explicit CC's-read marker, and the sieve does not red; (2) the sieve reds on a claim that DOES carry provenance in either direction (a false positive is the alarm-fatigue failure the andon literature names, and it kills the instrument faster than silence); (3) the sieve is prose in a SKILL.md or a charter rather than a runnable check — discipline wearing physics' clothes, which is the exact defect that let the SEAM label rot; (4) it runs only over one root, so a claim crossing cairn/ into CairnCommons/ escapes. HORIZON: re-read at the next corpus-wide correction. If a third instance of this shape lands (n=3) while the sieve is built and green, the sieve is measuring the wrong property and the node re-enters design rather than getting a patch.

distinctions_recorded: A TICKET FOR DOCUMENT CHANGES WAS CONSIDERED AND REJECTED, and the reasoning is kept because the proposal was Akien's and it was a good instinct pointed at the wrong mechanism. His version: ticket every document change, which forces an orientation during /sail. Why it fails against BOTH measured instances: an orientation checks a change against the corpus, and in both cases the corpus was uniformly wrong, so orientation would have compared the edit to four artifacts that agreed with it and gone GREEN. That is a check that could not have failed, now carrying a seal — strictly worse than no check, because the next reader cites it as evidence. He agreed: 'i'm good with those. yes.'

WHAT ACTUALLY DETECTS THIS CLASS TODAY IS AKIEN READING THE DOCUMENT, twice out of two. That is not luck: he is the only oracle standing outside the corpus, and prose is what forces a claim into a shape he can recognise as wrong. The brief is therefore already an instrument and should be treated as one. This node does not replace that loop; it tries to catch the cheap half earlier so his reading is spent on the hard half.

cairn/chart/ per-field provenance is PRECEDENT, not collision — same principle, different surface (a packet's field in flight vs an authored claim at rest). Borrow the shape; in-house prior art beats external.

filed_edges: [CORPUS] IS A DEFINITIONAL CLAIM MECHANICALLY SEPARABLE FROM A DESIGN STATEMENT? 'An inspector is a kind of learning block' is a definition; 'the engine is branchless about blocks' is a design statement. The sieve's whole feasibility rests on telling them apart at acceptable false-positive cost. Unmeasured. BUILDME measures it first; if it cannot, the fallback shape is a DECLARED-CLAIMS REGISTRY (the author marks the claim) rather than a detector (the scan finds it) — a different build, so this question is load-bearing before any code.

[CORPUS] WHAT COUNTS AS A SECOND ARTIFACT? The corpus spans two repos, JSON charters and markdown prose, and a QUOTATION of a claim is not a PROPAGATION of it — notes/held-learning-blocks-everywhere.json quotes the wrong anatomy today, correctly, above a supersede marker. A sieve that cannot tell quotation from assertion will red on every record of truth in the corpus.

[AKIEN] WHERE DOES IT BERTH? decisions/2026-08-05-filters-become-sieves is UNCONFIRMED, and it names the inspection family's word and its shared library. This node deliberately names a behaviour and not an address. THE SELF-INSPECTION HALF OF THIS QUESTION IS DISSOLVED, 2026-08-06: it read 'if this sieve inspects authored artifacts, and its own charter IS an authored artifact, decisions/2026-08-05-an-inspector-may-not-depend-on-what-it-inspects applies to it directly' — and that packet is retired, ruled conceptually false by Akien ('it's not physics. it's how things happen to be at the moment'). A sieve inspecting its own charter is not forbidden by anything; it is a trained self-inspection with no second line behind it, which is a design note, not a blocker. Only the berth question survives.
